sections.h2: Agriculture's share of rural jobs fell 5.6 points in two quarters

chart.title: Agriculture's share of rural employment fell every quarter, from 58.5% to 52.9%
chart.sub: Share of rural employed persons in agriculture (primary sector), %.

sections.means: Agriculture's share of rural employment fell from 58.5% to 52.9% across three quarters, a 5.6-point drop.
sections.todo: Compare the same two quarters over several years before reading this drop as a structural shift rather than the farming calendar.

sections.h2: The secondary sector absorbed most of the shift, up 3.5 points

chart.title: Rural secondary-sector share rose every quarter, from 20.9% to 24.4%
chart.sub: Share of rural employed persons in secondary (industry, construction), %.

sections.means: The secondary sector gained 3.5 points over the two quarters, more than the 2.1-point rise in services.
sections.todo: Check the state-level tables in the same bulletins to see whether this gain is broad-based or concentrated in a few states.

sections.h2: Rural unemployment rose 0.8 points over the same three quarters

chart.title: Rural unemployment rose every quarter, from 4.0% to 4.8%
chart.sub: Rural unemployment rate, persons aged 15 and above, All India, %.

sections.means: At least some people leaving farm work are not shown as employed anywhere else, since unemployment rose as farm share fell.
sections.todo: Treat the farm-to-non-farm transition story as incomplete until later bulletins show where the unemployed rural workers went.
